readings: Take the advanced behaviour records with a similarity to illicit patterns (`patsim`) greater than 0.439 and match each one to its transaction record(s), where `transactionrecord.transreg` equals `advancedbehavior.translink`; drop records with no match. For each order type mix (`ordertypedist`), treating a missing mix as its own group, show the order type mix and the number of matched records.
queries:
SELECT tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records
FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
  ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
WHERE ab.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY tr.ordertypedist
